# Non-Viral Delivery — Raw Sources

Detailed per-paper breakdowns (design, model/cohort, methods, quantitative results, limitations, conclusions) grounding the next-generation delivery-platform concepts. Each file is a leaf node (no `defines`) tagged with its true provenance weight — peer-reviewed primaries and clinical trials at high trust; conference posters and press figures explicitly flagged.

### Files

- [billingsley-2023-cd3-lnp.md](billingsley-2023-cd3-lnp.md) — Billingsley et al. 2023 — a fully ionizable anti-CD3-targeted LNP generates CAR-T in vivo (15–17% CAR+ at 12 h) and depletes 90% of B cells, outperforming the clinical MC3 lipid
- [breda-2023-cd117-hsc.md](breda-2023-cd117-hsc.md) — Breda et al. 2023 — anti-CD117-targeted LNPs edit 95% of hematopoietic stem cells in vivo and enable non-genotoxic conditioning, but still edit 76–79% of liver cells
- [cheng-2020-sort.md](cheng-2020-sort.md) — Cheng et al. 2020 — the founding SORT paper showing a single charged lipid reprograms LNP tropism to liver, lung, or spleen, enabling tissue-specific mRNA and CRISPR editing
- [chowdhury-2019-ecoli-cd47.md](chowdhury-2019-ecoli-cd47.md) — Chowdhury et al. 2019 — programmable E. coli with a synchronized lysis circuit releasing an anti-CD47 nanobody drives durable tumor regression, abscopal immunity, and memory in mice
- [grosskopf-2022-cart-hydrogel.md](grosskopf-2022-cart-hydrogel.md) — Grosskopf/Appel 2022 — a CAR-T-plus-IL-15 injectable hydrogel niche cures 100% of mice versus 10–40% for bolus, with >100-fold CAR-T expansion, in a solid-tumor model
- [janku-2021-clostridium.md](janku-2021-clostridium.md) — Janku et al. 2021 — intratumoral Clostridium novyi-NT spores germinate in 42% of patients and shrink injected tumors in 41%, proving an anaerobe can selectively lyse the hypoxic tumor core in humans
- [kalluri-2025-iexplore.md](kalluri-2025-iexplore.md) — Kalluri et al. 2025 (iEXPLORE) — first-in-human iExosome KRAS-G12D-siRNA trial: safe and target-engaging in pancreatic cancer but with no objective responses as monotherapy
- [kamerkar-2017-iexosome.md](kamerkar-2017-iexosome.md) — Kamerkar/Kalluri 2017 — iExosomes deliver KRAS-G12D siRNA to pancreatic tumors via CD47 shielding and KRAS-driven macropinocytosis, extending survival across multiple models
- [parhiz-2018-pecam-lnp.md](parhiz-2018-pecam-lnp.md) — Parhiz et al. 2018 — anti-PECAM-1-conjugated mRNA-LNPs redirect delivery to pulmonary endothelium with ~200-fold higher delivery and a ~200-fold lung-to-liver ratio, ApoE-independently
- [rurik-2022-cd5-cart.md](rurik-2022-cd5-cart.md) — Rurik/Epstein 2022 — a single injection of anti-CD5-targeted mRNA-LNP reprograms endogenous T cells into functional CAR-T in vivo, the landmark for LNP-based in-vivo CAR-T
- [sonabend-2023-sonocloud.md](sonabend-2023-sonocloud.md) — Sonabend et al. 2023 — an implantable ultrasound device repeatedly opens the blood-brain barrier, raising peritumoral paclitaxel 3.7× and carboplatin 5.9× in recurrent glioblastoma patients
- [tombacz-2021-cd4-lnp.md](tombacz-2021-cd4-lnp.md) — Tombácz et al. 2021 — anti-CD4-conjugated mRNA-LNPs recombine ~60% of splenic CD4 T cells in vivo with 33-fold selectivity, the highest in-vivo T-cell targeting of the antibody-LNP papers
- [toso-2002-salmonella.md](toso-2002-salmonella.md) — Toso et al. 2002 — attenuated Salmonella VNP20009 was safely dosed intravenously in 25 melanoma patients but colonized only 3 tumors with no responses, the translational-gap lesson for systemic bacterial delivery
- [wang-2020-sting-hydrogel.md](wang-2020-sting-hydrogel.md) — Wang/Cui 2020 — a STING-agonist + camptothecin supramolecular hydrogel drives ~100% regression of intracranial glioma, eliminates lung metastases (abscopal), and eliminates systemic toxicity
- [zhang-2019-homotypic-membrane.md](zhang-2019-homotypic-membrane.md) — Zhang et al. 2019 — homotypic cancer-cell-membrane-coated nanoparticles achieve 4–5× source-cell selectivity, ~75% less macrophage uptake, and ~90% tumor-volume reduction
- [zhu-2024-fus-review.md](zhu-2024-fus-review.md) — Zhu et al. 2024 — systematic review of focused-ultrasound BBB-opening clinical trials, aggregating drug-concentration gains (paclitaxel 3.7×, carboplatin 5.9×, temozolomide 7.7×, trastuzumab +450%) across 61 patients
